what: A small card drifts diagonally inside the screen (or its parent panel), 1.1px horizontally and .8px vertically per frame, and bounces off the walls to change direction, like an old screensaver logo. On interaction its speed drops 5% per frame until it glides to a stop, and on release it sets off again at the same rate.
ease: Eases in by a ratio per frame (.05)

options.ease: Ratio at which speed approaches the target when the hand enters and leaves, default .05 — at 0 it doesn’t react to the hand and keeps floating
options.within: parent bounces inside the parent panel, otherwise inside the screen
options.spread: Drifts away at a speed with a random 0 to this amount (px/frame) added per axis, default 0

use: Recent work card
note: Not applied on touch devices (hover false) or with reduced motion, and stays in place — the original also keeps cards at fixed positions on phones. This part uses transform, so do not stack it with another transform part on the same element (apply it to a wrapping element)
